reuse.why: The changes extend the existing shared pieces (recurConfigToRSchedule's module, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, RSchedule exrules, parseRecurDate) instead of writing parallel ones, and the new handler is built from those same pieces.

duplication.why: Building `new RSchedule({ rrules: recurConfigToRSchedule(c), exrules: recurConfigToExcludedRules(c) })` is now spelled out at three call sites, and getDatesInRange re-copies getUpcomingDates' `skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(date, mode, holidays) : date` mapping (already repeated in getNextDate and twice in schedule-template).

placement.why: The date rules (exclusion rules, holiday matching, weekend moves) live in shared/schedules.ts and the handler in the schedules app, matching the tree's layering, though the 'is a holiday' rule is split between the exrule builder and isHoliday.

scope.why: Every edit serves one of the four steps; tests and release notes accompany them and nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: Callers must remember to pair recurConfigToRSchedule with recurConfigToExcludedRules and to pass holidays to getDateWithSkippedWeekend; MM-DD vs full-date logic is encoded twice (exrule builder and isHoliday); the range margin `3 + 3 * holidays.length` is a heuristic; and the unknown-solve-mode branch of getDateWithSkippedWeekend is convoluted, throwing the same error from two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: New code goes through recurConfigToRSchedule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the weakness is that the shared helpers do not own the skipWeekend toggle or the exrule pairing, so callers repeat that glue

disguised_duplication.where: Holiday matching is encoded twice in different shapes: as YEARLY/DAILY exrules in recurConfigToExcludedRules and as `holidays.has(day) || holidays.has(day.slice(5))` in isHoliday; getDatesInRange's per-occurrence adjust+format is the getUpcomingDates mapping reshaped into a forEach with a Set

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a `holidays` parameter and a restructured unknown-mode branch with a holiday special case; recurConfigToExcludedRules special-cases daily frequency; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange each assemble rrules+exrules and the skipWeekend adjustment themselves instead of one shared 'occurrences with weekend handling' helper
